signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> {γ : Type u_3} -> {r : α → α → Prop} -> {s : β → β → Prop} -> {t : γ → γ → Prop} -> (g : s →r t) -> (f : r →r s) -> r →r t

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The composition of two relation homomorphisms is a total, well-defined operation for any composable pair; no junk-value or edge conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Type*} {r : α → α → Prop} {s : β → β → Prop} {t : γ → γ → Prop} (g : s →r t) (f : r →r s) {a b : α}, r a b → t ((VTask.comp g f) a) ((VTask.comp g f) b)
